description: This dashboard focuses on speed quality, latency risk, and throughput behavior. It helps teams detect regressions early and prioritize performance remediation by impact.

panels.title: Response Time Stats — today from raw · history from daily_summary

panels.description: This metric measures request speed, including slow-end latency risk where applicable. Persistent increases signal degrading user experience and should trigger performance triage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(weighted_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(total_requests), 0), 0) as value FROM (
  SELECT SUM(s.avg_response_time_ms * s.total_requests) as weighted_ms, SUM(s.total_requests) as total_requests
  FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day < CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT SUM(s.avg_response_time_ms * s.total_requests) as weighted_ms, SUM(s.total_requests) as total_requests
  FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE DATE(s.window_start) = CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
) combined

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(p50), 0) as value FROM (
  SELECT AVG(s.p50_response_time_ms) as p50
  FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day < CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT SUM(s.avg_response_time_ms * s.total_requests) / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0) as p50
  FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE DATE(s.window_start) = CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
) combined

panels.title: P50 Response Time

panels.description: This metric measures request speed, including slow-end latency risk where applicable. Persistent increases signal degrading user experience and should trigger performance triage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(p95), 0) as value FROM (
  SELECT AVG(s.p95_response_time_ms) as p95
  FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day < CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    (SELECT sub.response_time_ms FROM (
      SELECT response_time_ms,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY response_time_ms) as rn,
             COUNT(*) OVER () as total
      FROM proxy_requests r2
      JOIN proxies p2 ON r2.proxy_id = p2.device_id
      WHERE DATE(r2.timestamp) = CURDATE()
        AND r2.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL
        AND p2.location IN ($location)
    ) sub WHERE sub.rn = FLOOR(sub.total * 0.95) + 1 LIMIT 1) as p95
) combined

panels.title: P99 Response Time

panels.description: This metric measures request speed, including slow-end latency risk where applicable. Persistent increases signal degrading user experience and should trigger performance triage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_sec, avg_ms, p50_ms, p95_ms FROM (
  SELECT
    UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.day) as time_sec,
    ROUND(SUM(s.avg_response_time_ms * s.total_requests) / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 0) as avg_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(s.p50_response_time_ms), 0) as p50_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(s.p95_response_time_ms), 0) as p95_ms
  FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day < CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  GROUP BY s.day
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.window_start) / 3600) * 3600 as time_sec,
    ROUND(SUM(s.avg_response_time_ms * s.total_requests) / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 0) as avg_ms,
    ROUND(SUM(s.avg_response_time_ms * s.total_requests) / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 0) as p50_ms,
    NULL as p95_ms
  FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE DATE(s.window_start) = CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  GROUP BY FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.window_start) / 3600) * 3600
) combined
ORDER BY time_sec

panels.title: Avg / P50 / P95 Response Time Over Time (daily summary + today hourly)

panels.description: This panel shows which error categories are driving failures. It helps teams direct fixes toward the causes with highest customer impact.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_sec, timeout_count, connection_error_count, http_error_count, dns_error_count FROM (
  SELECT
    UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.day) as time_sec,
    SUM(s.timeout_count) as timeout_count,
    SUM(s.connection_error_count) as connection_error_count,
    SUM(s.http_error_count) as http_error_count,
    SUM(s.dns_error_count) as dns_error_count
  FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day < CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  GROUP BY s.day
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.window_start) / 3600) * 3600 as time_sec,
    SUM(s.timeout_count) as timeout_count,
    SUM(s.connection_error_count) as connection_error_count,
    SUM(s.http_error_count) as http_error_count,
    SUM(s.dns_error_count) as dns_error_count
  FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE DATE(s.window_start) = CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  GROUP BY FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.window_start) / 3600) * 3600
) combined
ORDER BY time_sec

panels.description: This panel provides proxy-level detail for performance and reliability diagnosis. It helps isolate exactly which proxies require immediate action.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_sec, avg_download_mbps, avg_upload_mbps FROM (
  SELECT
    UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.day) as time_sec,
    ROUND(AVG(s.avg_download_speed_mbps), 2) as avg_download_mbps,
    ROUND(AVG(s.avg_upload_speed_mbps), 2) as avg_upload_mbps
  FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day < CURDATE()
    AND s.avg_download_speed_mbps IS NOT NULL
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  GROUP BY s.day
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(r.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')) as time_sec,
    ROUND(AVG(r.download_speed_mbps), 2) as avg_download_mbps,
    ROUND(AVG(r.upload_speed_mbps), 2) as avg_upload_mbps
  FROM proxy_requests r
  JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE DATE(r.timestamp) = CURDATE()
    AND r.download_speed_mbps IS NOT NULL
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  GROUP BY UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(r.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'))
) combined
ORDER BY time_sec

panels.description: This metric measures request speed, including slow-end latency risk where applicable. Persistent increases signal degrading user experience and should trigger performance triage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT proxy_name, location, total_requests, success_rate_pct, avg_response_ms, p95_response_ms, p99_response_ms, timeout_count, source FROM (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(p.name, s.proxy_id) as proxy_name,
    s.location,
    SUM(s.total_requests) as total_requests,
    ROUND(SUM(s.success_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 1) as success_rate_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(s.avg_response_time_ms * s.total_requests) / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 0) as avg_response_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(s.p95_response_time_ms), 0) as p95_response_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(s.p99_response_time_ms), 0) as p99_response_ms,
    SUM(s.timeout_count) as timeout_count,
    'summary' as source
  FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day < CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  GROUP BY s.proxy_id, p.name, s.location
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    COALESCE(p.name, p.device_id) as proxy_name,
    p.location,
    SUM(s.total_requests) as total_requests,
    ROUND(SUM(s.success_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 1) as success_rate_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(s.avg_response_time_ms * s.total_requests) / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 0) as avg_response_ms,
    NULL as p95_response_ms,
    NULL as p99_response_ms,
    SUM(s.timeout_count) as timeout_count,
    'today' as source
  FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
  WHERE DATE(s.window_start) = CURDATE()
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  GROUP BY p.device_id, p.name, p.location
) combined
ORDER BY avg_response_ms DESC
LIMIT 20
